item.title: Colombian president taunts arrested supermarket hostage-takers
item.description: Colombia’s president has confronted the men who held 76 people hostage at a Cartagena supermarket.

item.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei denies wanting humanity to ‘surrender’ free will to AI
item.description: Dario Amodei's remarks come amid predictions that AI may soon match or surpass human intelligence.

item.title: FIFA turns to influencers to promote U17 World Cup
item.description: FIFA has enlisted social media influencers to promote the Under-17 World Cup in Qatar.

item.title: Kim Jong Un says North Korea should widen deployment of tactical nukes
item.description: North Korean leader warns attempts to deny country's nuclear status will be seen as "an open declaration of war".

item.title: Photos: Storms and an El Nino-charged king tide batter California’s coast
item.description: Meteorologists have warned that the king tide could pair with high surf to bring historic surges to parts of the state.

item.title: Ukraine attacks Russian military base, says five planes struck
item.description: The Ukrainian General Staff says its forces struck an airbase in the Nizhny Novgorod region east of Moscow.

item.title: ICE officers smash car window, pepper spray bystanders
item.description: Masked ICE agents smashed a car window and forcibly opened its door to arrest a man in California.

item.title: Judges recommend prosecutors end corruption case against Netanyahu
item.description: Israeli judges have ruled there is little prospect Benjamin Netanyahu will be convicted of corruption.

item.title: Storms push Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City to Saturday
item.description: The parade, which marks its 100th edition, got a last-minute rain check ahead of heavy gusts on Thursday.

item.title: ISIL blamed for multiple suicide attacks in Syria
item.description: ISIL suicide attack kills two in an assault on a security post in northeastern Syria.

item.title: Two Syrian security personnel killed in ISIL suicide attack
item.description: Syrian forces say the attack in northeastern Syria's city of Hasakah involved four assailants who were all killed.

item.title: Zambia bans protest against push to remove presidential term limits
item.description: Critics fear the campaign could undermine democratic safeguards as senior opposition figures remain behind bars.

item.title: A meeting with Democrats over healthcare? Trump says he’s open to it
item.description: Experts tell Al Jazeera they are sceptical that Trump would back Medicare for All, a proposal for national healthcare.

item.title: Iran war live: Explosion rocks Sanaa; missiles intercepted over Riyadh
item.description: A blast hits Sanaa after air strikes near the airport, as the Saudi coalition intercepts missiles over Riyadh.

item.title: Houthis target Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea ports as strikes escalate
item.description: Explosion reported in Sanaa after Saudi air defenses intercept ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh.

item.title: King tides and big waves batter coastal California
item.description: Massive waves batter California as El Nino-driven storms bring king tides to the US West Coast.

item.title: Deadly truck fire is latest of Egypt’s transport disasters
item.description: Dozens were killed and injured when a truck carrying gas cylinders caught fire near Cairo’s Ring Road.

item.title: Malen and Roma deny injury-hit PSG in Champions League draw
item.description: Champions League holders Paris Saint-Germain held to 2-2 draw by Roma as injury-ravaged squad struggle.

item.title: Man United denied at Sporting as referee overshadows Fernandes double
item.description: Bruno Fernandes nets twice in Lisbon, but referee's decisions in spotlight as Mauricio Pochettino denied first win.

item.title: Winter rains threaten 1,000 Gaza shelter sites, councils warn
item.description: About 200,000 tents need replacing, Gaza’s municipalities say, as the EU urges Israel to reopen all crossings.

item.title: US Education Department probes Virginia schools after sexual abuse scandal
item.description: Virginia schools face scrutiny after revelations of abuse and widespread failures in mandatory staff background checks.

item.title: Baby Aliyah steals the show during Australian Senate debate
item.description: Australian Senator Fatima Payman addressed the Senate with her six-month-old daughter, Aliyah, in her arms

item.title: What’s behind Europe’s protests?
item.description: Increase in protests and industrial disputes across EU and UK.

item.title: Netanyahu says corruption trial ‘must end’ as court suggests dropping case
item.description: The judges' recommendations came as Israel's longest-serving prime minister fights for his political survival.

item.title: Migrant wrongly deported by Trump leaves US for Spain
item.description: Kilmar Abrego Garcia has arrived in Spain with his wife after a 20-month legal battle with the Trump administration.
